verdict.rationale: Linear supports asynchronous discussion inside the planning tool: inline comments on issue description text and images, threaded comment replies with @mentions, and line-level comments on code from mobile. There is no evidence of a real-time team chat or messaging surface, and the Slack integration that syncs threads suggests live conversation happens outside Linear. Missing for 10: real-time chat or direct messaging between teammates, channel or group conversations, and independent or hands-on corroboration of in-tool discussion.
